status: formal applicability reviewed; individual rare forms still require error adjudication before release
reasoning: 3.1.32 gives sanadi-derived stems dhatu status. 3.1.26 licenses nic in a causative context; 3.1.7 licenses desiderative san with the relevant subject relation. Alternating chains apply each operation to a newly derived stem. This recursive application is an inference from the rules, not a claim of attestation of every long form.
restrictions: No direct san+san: the commentary on 3.1.7 expressly excludes desideratives directly on an iccha-san stem.
Every repeated san in this pilot follows a fresh nic causative.
Intensive yaN occurs only as the initial operation, on roots accepted by the engine; Curadi is excluded.
Only Lit, Lut and AshirLin are sampled; the unresolved aorist transformations are not used.
Only reviewed SLP1 prefixes are accepted. Every case is regenerated and checked before paid submission.
limitations: Grammatical conditions and closure argument support a formal pilot, not blanket independent certification of all VP outputs. Audit systematic model/oracle disagreements before selecting final recipes.
